<module id="calendar">
    <description>Perpetual Calendar</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="RST">Active high reset signal.</input>
        <output id="Hours" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current hours.</output>
        <output id="Mins" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current minutes.</output>
        <output id="Secs" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current seconds.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // First always block for updating Seconds
        always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                Secs <= 0;
            end else if (Secs == 59) begin
                Secs <= 0;
            end else begin
                Secs <= Secs + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Second always block for updating Minutes
        always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                Mins <= 0;
            end else if ((Mins == 59) && (Secs == 59)) begin
                Mins <= 0;
            end else if (Secs == 59) begin
                Mins <= Mins + 1;
            end else begin
                Mins <= Mins;
            end
        end
        
        // Third always block for updating Hours
        always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                Hours <= 0;
            end else if ((Hours == 23) && (Mins == 59) && (Secs == 59)) begin
                Hours <= 0;
            end else if ((Mins == 59) && (Secs == 59)) begin
                Hours <= Hours + 1;
            end else begin
                Hours <= Hours;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
